reason: the pre-GPU gate fired on the baselines, so there was nothing for a distilled corpus to train. No API call was made and no corpus was purchased.

rendered_prompt.caveat: estimated, not counted -- messages.count_tokens needs credentials this environment lacks. 2.8 ch/tok is conservative so input prices are upper bounds.

rate_source.caveat: if the table has drifted since 2026-06-24 every price below drifts with it

budget.note: adaptive thinking bills thinking as output and Opus 5 thinks by default, so three output scenarios are priced rather than one

stop_number.note: ~$8 is not a budget question, and the memory ledger showed 1.92 GiB fits a free T4. Nothing in this phase is gated by cost, which forces the gate to fire on evidence instead.

label_distribution.note: THIS is the majority baseline, and it is neither 50% nor the raw base rate. Under GroupKFold by test class the held-out class is homogeneous, so the training majority mispredicts the whole fold -- worse than chance, not at it.
